unit: Center for International Environment and Resource Policy

labs.lab_name: Center for International Environment and Resource Policy (CIERP)
labs.research_summary: Fletcher School center, founded in 1992, that does research and graduate training on environment, climate, water and development policy and houses two labs.
labs.member_breakdown: 2 co-directors, 4 staff, 3 research and postdoctoral scholars, 8 research fellows (predoctoral and junior)
labs.join_notes: Students can work as research or teaching assistants, often with the two labs. For open RA or TA positions the page says to email Alyssa Scheiner (alyssa.scheiner@tufts.edu). A separate Internships page offers CIERP-funded internships with an application and the same contact.
labs.notes: Second co-director is Melissa McCracken (melissa.mccracken@tufts.edu). Count leaves out 16 Fletcher faculty, 12 faculty and research affiliates and 5 senior fellows. Staff phones are on the people page. The cached 'careers' page was alumni career stories; the RA and internship pages were fetched (2 of 3 extra fetches).
